# Potala Guide
> The most complete English-language guide to Potala Palace, Lhasa, Tibet. Updated August 2026.

## Essential Pages

- [Home](https://tibet-lhasa-potala.com/): Complete visitor guide overview with tickets, tips, and travel info.
- [Visit Guide](https://tibet-lhasa-potala.com/visit/): Tickets, hours, routes, interior room guide, and practical visit details.
- [Travel Permits](https://tibet-lhasa-potala.com/permits/): Tibet Travel Permit requirements, application process, and common mistakes.
- [History](https://tibet-lhasa-potala.com/history/): 1,300 years of history, architecture, murals, artifacts, and UNESCO heritage.
- [Photography Guide](https://tibet-lhasa-potala.com/photography/): Best photo spots, sunrise/sunset timing, camera settings, and drone rules.

## Plan Your Trip

- [Travel Tips](https://tibet-lhasa-potala.com/travel-tips/): Altitude advice, packing list, safety, insurance, and practical preparation.
- [Best Time to Visit](https://tibet-lhasa-potala.com/best-time/): Month-by-month weather, festival calendar, and crowd levels.
- [Lhasa Attractions](https://tibet-lhasa-potala.com/lhasa-attractions/): Jokhang Temple, Barkhor Street, Sera Monastery, and day trips.
- [Lhasa Food Guide](https://tibet-lhasa-potala.com/lhasa-food/): Tibetan dishes, restaurants near Potala, vegetarian and halal options.
- [Hotels with Potala View](https://tibet-lhasa-potala.com/hotels-potala-view/): Luxury, mid-range, and budget hotels with real palace views.
- [Getting to Lhasa](https://tibet-lhasa-potala.com/lhasa-transport/): Flights, Qinghai-Tibet Railway, airport transfers, and city transport.

## About This Site

Independently published travel guide. Not affiliated with official tourism authorities. Content is researched and updated regularly, with the most recent comprehensive update in August 2026.
